Headers of AMD's FidelityFX SDK v2.3.0 (`Kits/FidelityFX/api` and `Kits/FidelityFX/framegeneration`), MIT licensed
(the notice is in each file). Only the API declarations: `ffx_probe.hpp` hooks the game's own
`amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll` and reads/rewrites the frame generation descriptors it passes.
